Giant Connect Four

From $125 CAD

Bring oversized fun to your event with our Giant Connect Four game!

This larger-than-life version of the classic game is perfect for players of all ages.

Guests take turns dropping colorful discs into the frame, aiming to connect four in a row while blocking their opponent's moves.

Ideal for weddings, parties, or corporate events, this game guarantees hours of entertainment and adds a playful touch to any celebration.
